approval_case.title: Keep concurrent requests separate after session loss
approval_case.situation: Hao starts a repeated-reply investigation and then a Gym training request. The first owner finishes after its original May session is gone.
approval_case.hao_request: Keep both requests moving and report the verified repeated-reply result to the right conversation.
approval_case.correct_behavior: May gives each request its own trace, accountable owner, terminal proof, completion wake, and missed-progress checkpoint before promising a later result. When the repeated-reply owner finishes, a fresh May turn reviews root-cause, regression, and restart-replay proof, replies to the repeated-reply request exactly once, and leaves Gym training active.
